meta.name: Reference Wells
meta.purpose: A balanced catalog of cultural 'wells' a songwriter draws allusions from — biblical, mythic, historical eras, decade nostalgia, regional textures, cosmic. Each well lists signature images with meanings, the tone it carries, and what it evokes. This is a scaffold, not a closed list: the reference-finder Skill uses it to generate deep, on-theme references on demand and to keep coverage across wells balanced.
meta.how_to_use: Browse to find a well's texture and signature images, or feed a well/theme to the reference-finder Skill to go deeper. References color the SETUP of a song (verse imagery, gravity, texture); they pair with an impact phrase, which lands the punch.

field_guide.name: the well's name
field_guide.category: grouping (sacred-mythic, myth, literary, folklore, esoteric, decade, historical-era, regional-genre, cosmic, domain, nature)
field_guide.evokes: themes/feelings it is strong for — the meaning axis
field_guide.signatures: signature reference images, each with img (the allusion) and means (what it evokes / how it reads)
field_guide.deploy: craft note on using this well in a lyric
field_guide.cliche_watch: the most overused images in this well — use sparingly or twist

wells.name: Biblical / Scripture

signatures.means: betrayal disguised as affection
a burden you carry as penance
transformation through trial
lost innocence, paradise before the fall
the one who leaves and is welcomed back
the cheap price of a betrayal
a stretch of testing and temptation
a hard climb toward the divine
the impossible done by faith
deliverance you may never reach
the doom you can already read
grace instead of vengeance
walking through fear and death

wells.deploy: Biblical images carry instant moral gravity — one lands a whole verse in the register of sin and grace. Great for songs about betrayal, guilt, and redemption. Twist the worn ones (a Judas who kisses himself in the mirror).

wells.name: Greek & Roman Myth

signatures.means: flying too high, undone by your own ambition
the one fatal weakness in the strong
the ruin you can't put back once opened
a beautiful lure toward destruction
getting everything you wanted and it kills you
the point of no return / death's ferry
endless, pointless struggle
losing love the instant you doubt
drowning in your own reflection
the gift that carries your undoing
punished forever for a gift to others
lost in a maze of your own making

wells.deploy: Myth turns a personal feeling into a fated, cosmic one — good for tragedy, obsession, and grand doomed love. The story-shape does the work; you rarely need to explain it.

wells.name: Norse & Celtic Myth

signatures.means: the foretold end you march toward anyway
a glorious reward earned only through death
a life already being woven and cut
everything connected by one root
an omen, a messenger between worlds
a cold that outlasts hope
a spectral chase across the night sky
a wild love that must return to the sea
the night the dead walk close
a fate written in something that outlasts you

wells.deploy: Northern myth brings cold stoicism and inevitability — perfect for endurance, grief, and doomed courage. Leans folk and elemental; pairs with weather and wilderness imagery.

wells.name: Shakespeare & Classic Literature

signatures.means: love the universe itself is against
guilt that won't wash off
jealousy that devours from inside

signatures.img: to be or not to be
signatures.means: the edge between going on and not
a debt collected cruelly, to the letter
a long cold season of the soul
holding death and looking it in the face
love reaching across an impossible distance
a loud life that meant nothing
the obsession that will sink you (Melville)

signatures.img: the green light across the water
signatures.means: the dream just out of reach (Gatsby)
grief that keeps saying nevermore (Poe)

wells.deploy: Literary allusion adds eloquence and tragic scale. Works when the song wants to feel timeless and literate; keep the reference light so it colors rather than shows off.
cliche_watch: 'to be or not to be' quoted straight

wells.name: Fairy Tale & Folklore

signatures.means: a way home that disappears behind you
a sweetness that puts you to sleep
a fit that proves who you really are — or doesn't
an impossible promise with a hidden price
the danger dressed up as something safe
beauty locked away, waiting
what looks lowly holding what you need
hope you throw away and never get back
a bargain made in the dark
ruin waiting just outside

signatures.img: the girl in the red hood
signatures.means: innocence walking straight toward the teeth

wells.deploy: Folklore gives childhood-dark texture — familiar and unsettling at once. Strong for songs about lost innocence, temptation, and false safety. The dark undertow is the point.

wells.name: Tarot & the Occult

signatures.means: sudden collapse of what you built
an ending that is really a change, not a grave

signatures.img: the Fool at the cliff's edge
signatures.means: a reckless, hopeful first step into nothing
surrender, seeing the world upside down
luck turning, high to low and back
a choice as much as a romance
looking for the future in scraps

signatures.img: crossing a stranger's palm with silver
signatures.means: paying for a truth you may not want
small omens of a turning tide
reaching for someone past the veil

wells.deploy: Occult imagery brings fate and dread with a whisper. Good for foreboding, transformation, and songs that flirt with the mystical. The Tower and Death cards are rich because they mean the opposite of how they look.
cliche_watch: crystal ball as a lazy prop

wells.name: Old West & Frontier

signatures.means: a reckoning you can't walk away from
leaving before the town can hold you
a final chance to escape
a place love and money already left
a past that follows your face
chasing a fortune that ruins you
freedom that is really loneliness
the cheap end of a hard life
a beautiful lie sold door to door
the choice you save for yourself
trouble or salvation coming, can't tell which

wells.deploy: Frontier imagery is pure mythic-Americana — freedom, violence, and loneliness in wide open space. Perfect for outlaw hearts, restlessness, and reinvention. Pairs with country, folk, and rock.
cliche_watch: ride off into the sunset (unless twisted)

wells.name: Prohibition & the Jazz Age

signatures.means: pleasure you need a password for
a homemade vice that might blind you

signatures.img: the last dance before the crash
signatures.means: joy on the edge of ruin
borrowed glamour hiding empty pockets
a life ready to bolt at any second

signatures.img: the green light across the bay
signatures.means: a dream you reach for and never touch
defiant, disposable freedom
a charming man who deals in lies
where the real deals get made
the moment the good times died

wells.deploy: Jazz Age imagery = glamour with rot underneath, the party you know is doomed. Great for reckless love, excess, and bittersweet highs. Cinematic and sensual.

wells.name: Great Depression & the Dust Bowl

signatures.means: disaster rolling in, slow and total
pride swallowed to survive

signatures.img: the family piled in the truck
signatures.means: leaving everything to chase work west
working hard and holding nothing
losing the land your name was on

signatures.img: patched knees and a straight back
signatures.means: poverty carried with dignity
clinging to a shared thread of hope

signatures.img: the last dollar sewn in a coat
signatures.means: a small guarded hope against the worst
chasing survival from town to town
praying for a mercy the sky won't give

wells.deploy: Dust Bowl imagery brings weathered dignity and endurance — hardship faced with a straight back. Strong for songs about struggle, family, and stubborn hope. Woody-Guthrie-adjacent; pairs with folk and Americana.

wells.name: Film Noir & Detective

signatures.means: a city that keeps its secrets wet and bright
a love that's setting you up
waiting alone for bad news

signatures.img: the long shadow down the alley
signatures.means: a man at the end of his options
truth you only see in stripes

signatures.img: a one-way ticket out of town
signatures.means: a clean escape that never stays clean
the partner who was against you all along

signatures.img: the payoff in a brown envelope
signatures.means: a soul bought quietly
trouble that arrives looking like a rescue
the moment you realize you're alone in it

wells.deploy: Noir is cynical romance in the rain — desire, betrayal, and doom in a nighttime city. Perfect for songs about being played, wanting what's bad for you, and glamorous defeat.

wells.name: 1950s Americana
wells.tone: bright surface, teenage, chrome-and-heartbreak, uneasy underneath

signatures.means: first love in the front seat
belonging you wear on your sleeve
small-town innocence, now gone
restless youth with nowhere to be
a promise too young to keep

signatures.img: chrome fins and a full tank
signatures.means: the open promise of the American car
joy before anyone had to grow up
the dream that felt like a cage
a nickel's worth of feeling
dread humming under the bright surface

wells.deploy: 50s imagery = bright chrome nostalgia with unease underneath. Great for young love, longing for a lost innocence, and the tension between the picket fence and wanting out.

wells.name: 1960s Counterculture
wells.tone: idealistic, electric, searching, on the cusp

signatures.means: gentleness answering violence

signatures.img: the long march / the picket line
signatures.means: putting your body where your belief is
a brief window when anything seemed possible
escape and reinvention on the move
refusing a fate assigned to you
a vision of justice glimpsed, not reached
turning away from a world that lies to you
grief held up as a light

signatures.img: the road trip with no map
signatures.means: freedom as pure forward motion

wells.deploy: 60s imagery brings idealism and electric hope, shadowed by what it cost. Strong for protest, awakening, and love framed as defiance. Handle real figures/events with a light, respectful touch.

wells.name: 1980s

signatures.means: glamour and loneliness in the same glow
a whole heart handed over on cassette

signatures.img: a payphone and a pocket of quarters
signatures.means: reaching someone before it was easy
escape by the token, one more life
outrunning a feeling on the highway
a grand, public, hopeless gesture
dressing tough to survive the decade

signatures.img: the last slow dance in the gym
signatures.means: teenage love under crepe-paper stars
a memory you keep rewinding
a bright empty temple of wanting

wells.deploy: 80s imagery is neon yearning — big feelings, synthetic glow, escape on the highway. Great for nostalgia, first heartbreak, and glossy loneliness. Pairs naturally with synth-pop and driving choruses.

wells.name: 1990s Nostalgia

signatures.means: the sound of the world slowly opening
having to earn a memory back

signatures.img: the mixtape with the hand-drawn cover
signatures.means: love that took two hours to record
small tender responsibility
a person you simply couldn't reach

signatures.img: passing a note folded into a triangle
signatures.means: a secret you could hold in your hand
27 tries and you wouldn't see them for a week
faith that a little effort would fix it

signatures.img: the landline cord stretched down the hall
signatures.means: privacy fought for, whispered for

signatures.img: the mall food court after school
signatures.means: a whole social life in fluorescent light
saying how you feel without saying it to them
freedom that felt like it would last forever

wells.deploy: 90s imagery is analog-tender: earnest, lo-fi, the last era before everything was instant. Perfect for nostalgia, young friendship, and first love that took effort to reach. The friction (busy signals, rewinding, waiting) IS the romance.
cliche_watch: just listing brand names for their own sake

wells.name: 2000s / Y2K

signatures.img: the away message that was really for one person
signatures.means: a public post meant privately
a mixtape for the digital age
ending a call with punctuation
a connection about to drop
love and status ranked in public
waiting for an ending that didn't come
wanting something that won't quite load
trying on an identity that won't age well
the last of film meeting the first of digital
a room of strangers who felt like home

wells.deploy: Y2K imagery = the digital dawn, glossy and anxious. Good for coming-of-age-online, early internet love, and reinvention. Bittersweet because it's the moment before the feed swallowed everything.

wells.name: Southern Gothic

signatures.means: the past overgrowing the present
salvation sold under canvas, sweat and hope
trying to wash a sin off in brown water
tension that won't let up
the dead you live on top of

signatures.img: the porch light and the moths
signatures.means: small hope circled by hungry things
sin and salvation drunk from the same cup
a bargain with something you can't name
grandeur rotting on a rotten foundation
piety worn thin over what you did

wells.deploy: Southern Gothic braids the sacred and the sinful in humid, haunted air. Powerful for guilt, redemption, family curses, and heat. Pairs with country, blues, and slow-burn ballads.

wells.name: Blues & Gospel Tradition

signatures.means: trading your soul for the gift
leaving trouble, carrying it with you
a doom that keeps pace with you
crossing over to the other side / freedom / death
a charm to turn your luck

signatures.img: a mansion on the hill you'll never own
signatures.means: the reward that stays out of reach
a pressure that will flood everything
a soul just passing through this world of woe
the plainest shape of the blues
trouble crossed on faith

wells.deploy: Blues and gospel imagery is the root of American song — trouble and grace in the same breath, sacred and secular blurred. Great for heartache, hard travel, and deliverance. Use with respect for the tradition.
cliche_watch: 'sold my soul at the crossroads' overused
'woke up this morning' as a lazy opener

wells.name: Nautical & Seafaring

signatures.means: a beautiful call toward wreckage
a guide home you can see but not reach
weight that holds you, for good or ill

signatures.img: the sailor's wife at the window
signatures.means: a love that is mostly waiting
trouble you can see coming and can't avoid
a plea sent out with no promise of arrival
a hope or a leaving, growing small
an obsession or grief too big to hold
a rescue that can't take everyone
a love or a chance quietly withdrawing

wells.deploy: Sea imagery is vast and lonesome — perfect for distance, longing, and fate too big to fight. The lighthouse (guidance just out of reach) and the tide (love withdrawing) are especially strong. Pairs with folk and swelling ballads.

wells.name: Space Race & Cosmic

signatures.means: a voice fading into the dark
staying close but never touching

signatures.img: the flag on a dead moon
signatures.means: a triumph planted somewhere lifeless

signatures.img: a light from a star already gone
signatures.means: loving something that no longer exists
the speed it takes to finally leave for good
a point past which there's no aborting

signatures.img: the blue marble from far away
signatures.means: seeing home whole and unreachable
the loneliness the wonder is set against

signatures.img: a satellite still transmitting to no one
signatures.means: devotion that outlives its purpose
a pull you can't argue with

wells.deploy: Cosmic imagery makes a feeling vast and lonely at once — great for distance, longing, and awe. 'Light from a dead star' (loving what's gone) and 'orbit' (close but never touching) are rich, fresh moves. Pairs with spacious, reverb-heavy production.

wells.name: Nature, Seasons & the Pastoral

signatures.means: the moment warmth turns to endings
stubborn hope against the season

signatures.img: the river that never passes the same way
signatures.means: a moment you can't step in twice
reaping a life's choices

signatures.img: the drought and the long-prayed-for rain
signatures.means: an ache and its relief
a pull that governs you from far away

signatures.img: the wildfire that clears for new growth
signatures.means: destruction that makes room
the instinct to leave and to return
life waiting out a cold season

signatures.img: the tree ring / the scar in the wood
signatures.means: a hard year written into you for good

wells.deploy: Nature imagery carries change and grief gently, through cycles. Seasons map onto love and time without you having to explain. 'Last leaf holding on' and 'seed under the snow' are quietly powerful. Universal and always singable.
